title: HtmlInputWeek
responsibility: Renders the native input control with type week without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlInputWeek.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet supplied as children and separated from the other props before they are spread onto the element. The input is empty, so this snippet is not rendered.

outputs.name: HtmlInputWeek
outputs.description: A native input element receives the remaining props through the attribute spread, followed by the fixed type="week" attribute. The element has no wrapper and renders no child content.
